description.short: Read-only shopping decisions, offers, and prices in Greece.
description.full: BestPrice helps you decide what to buy among physical products sold in Greece. Ask for a recommendation within a budget, find a specific product, compare current shop offers with the delivered total to a Greek postcode, or check whether today's price is low or high against the last 180 days. All tools are read-only and use live BestPrice catalog data in euros. No BestPrice account or API key is needed, and BestPrice never places orders or takes payments.

agentConnectors.description: Read-only shopping decisions, product search, offers, and price history for Greece. Public endpoint, no sign-in.
